senses.gloss:
kéta, m. intention; desire; will. [√cit,
‘look, be intent upon.’]

ketú, m. brightness; pl. beams. [√cit,
‘look, appear, shine’: cf. Goth. haidu-s,
(‘appearance, manner,’ i. e.) ‘way,’ AS.
hād, ‘way, manner, condition,’ Eng. -hood,
-head (as in maidenhood, godhead), Ger.
-heit: cf. under maya.]
